sensorFinding.verdict: Latest main sensor Lumen claim is unsupported and its current source clears the very overrides UE requires for independent scene captures.
sensorFinding.engine_behavior: UE 5.8 sets independent scene capture GI and reflections to None before applying component postprocess overrides. World/project Lumen settings alone do not opt these captures in.
sensorFinding.main_behavior: DroneFoundation.cpp clears bOverride_DynamicGlobalIlluminationMethod and bOverride_ReflectionMethod, while reporting lighting=world. That metadata is not evidence of a Lumen pass.
sensorFinding.integration_hazard: Do not carry those clearing assignments into valley. Preserve Cosys explicit Lumen opt-in and the prepared runtime prerequisites guard.
sensorFinding.limitations: A source finding is not a direct measurement of the historical binary sensor render passes. Existing timing measurements remain contextual observations with their recorded workload, not valley results.

capabilityVerdict.lumen_gi: Supported for ordinary 2D captures when explicitly enabled in component postprocess settings, with a persistent view state, enabled show flags and supported tracing data.
capabilityVerdict.lumen_reflections: Supported under explicit capture reflection override, allowed view, reflection show flag and tracing support.
capabilityVerdict.hardware_ray_tracing: Requires enabled platform ray tracing, inline or ray-generation support, r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing and ray tracing allowed for the view. The capture component opt-in feeds the view, subject to the scene capture cvar.
capabilityVerdict.virtual_shadow_maps: Deferred final-color rendering initializes VSM when the platform, project, runtime and DynamicShadows show flag allow it; no ordinary scene-capture exclusion was found at this gate.
capabilityVerdict.nanite: Config can enable the renderer but does not convert assets or build landscape Nanite data. Actual asset usage remains unverified.
capabilityVerdict.instrumentation: Prepared component assertions check required inputs. They cannot observe final render-thread FViewInfo decisions or executed GPU passes. No unsupported private-renderer instrumentation added.
